runtime_dependencies.change: Every dependency image layer and runtime environment variable is retained. Only the installed Vflash wheel and source/version labels change.

qualification.package: All 59 installed package files match the reviewed core revision. Both images pass CPU installation, native import, CLI, service-construction and writable-cache checks as UID 10001. Pipeline adapter dependencies and media executables remain valid.
qualification.qkv: The automatic direct merge is limited to strict SM89 Ref4 v0.1. Its kernel and launch match the target-GPU-tested implementation, including identical compiled SM89 machine instructions. A complete 50-layer, four-step native trajectory with 200 direct merges preserved both final FP32 audio/video tensors bit-for-bit; CPU checks additionally cover the public dispatch and ownership.
qualification.reuse: The 0.3.0 complete pipeline, media, T2VA and SM86 qualifications remain attached to their unchanged implementations. No additional whole-pipeline GPU execution is claimed for the final 0.3.1 images.
qualification.limits: The QKV result is numerical and local temporary-memory evidence. It establishes neither a new prompt-to-MP4 latency figure nor broader semantic quality.
